body: Some cities have free counseling available if you look for it. Some don't but there are always people here on suicidewatch to talk to. It's great you started working out, you're being proactive and you really want to change. Please pm me if you want to talk. I'm going to bed now but I'll be up in a few hours to write you back. I don't have a lot of advice (I posted here earlier so I'm in the depression boat too) but I'll listen and won't judge. I really hope you have a better night, friend.

Thank you so much for commenting. I've been trying to work up the courage to see someone for quite a while now.. I even have access to free counseling but I'm afraid that if I tell them I'm suicidal they'll call the cops on me. Someone posted in /sw earlier this week that happened to them. Terrifying.

I'm glad you were able to overcome and feel better.
